existing_schema_capability: canonical product and exact expected/observed MPN
retailer, source and source-policy foreign keys
item price minor units, currency and VAT

individual successful and failed target attempts

direct_load_blockers: collector availability value other is outside SQL enum
collector extract SHA-256 may be null while SQL requires one
delivery destination may be null while SQL requires text
collector observation IDs may violate SQL key format
collector and SQL qualification vocabularies differ
most collector MPNs lack mandatory canonical-product SQL rows

coverage.conclusion: Current registry breadth cannot generally support the desired five-to-ten retailers per exact MPN; source expansion and/or a narrower deeper tracked set is required. No exact set or source family is selected.

approved_direction_for_design: retain immutable Git artefacts as acquisition authority
design an idempotent post-collection PostgreSQL importer rather than direct collector writes
preserve source JSON/evidence losslessly before normalisation
persist every target attempt so matrix blanks have auditable reasons
create deterministic latest-offer and coverage views
retain checksum-bound static frontend export initially
favour retailer depth over broad shallow catalogue coverage without selecting methodology or basket
